resources.string: Compare charging, low-battery and critical colors on dark and light status-bar backgrounds.
Master switch. Turn off to restore the stock battery and signal icons.
Which arrangement to draw. The ring is the default; the rectangular one puts a column of signal dots on each side of the centre and a battery bar across the bottom.

Draw the glyph in its own window so it is not clipped to the status-bar height (about 43 dp), allowing the whole icon to show. The lower part of the glyph then hangs outside the status-bar background. Turn off to draw inside the bar again.
Draw the Wi-Fi arcs; the number of arcs follows the real signal level. Turn off to send the stock Wi-Fi icon back to its usual place in the status bar.
Draw four level dots for mobile network signal strength. Turn off to send the stock mobile icon back to its usual place in the status bar.

Show the battery percentage inside the ring. While charging, the selected charging display mode shows only the bolt or alternates the bolt and battery number every 5 seconds. Centred-number mode does not alternate. When off, the native charging bolt is restored.
Turn off to drop the bolt from the ring and let the stock charging bolt show next to the battery icon instead.

Charging color takes priority over low and critical colors. Choose the bolt only, or alternate the bolt and battery number every 5 seconds. This also applies when the battery number occupies the ring opening.

Enlarge the percentage into the middle of the ring and always keep it there. The Wi-Fi arcs shrink into the top notch, a smaller bolt takes the notch while charging (the arcs are then dropped), and an in-ring network type moves into the notch too.
Where to show the network type label: off, inside the ring, or as a separate icon elsewhere in the status bar.
Where the mobile signal reading lives. Inside the ring keeps the level dots along the bottom of the icon; outside moves it beside the battery icon, in whichever form the switch below selects.

Choose where to show dual-SIM signal dots: Off, at the top and bottom of the ring, or below the ring. When both SIM levels are readable, both are shown; otherwise, the icon falls back to the active data SIM.

Draw the reading yourself while it is outside the ring: four bars of increasing height for one SIM, a row of dots below them for the other. With a single SIM, only the bars are drawn. Turned off, the system\'s own mobile signal icon is kept.
With two SIMs, draw only the reading of the SIM that carries data and leave the other one out. A single SIM, or one whose data SIM cannot be read, is unaffected.
Pick colors for low battery, charging and critical battery.
Use the low-battery color at %1$d%% or below.
Critical battery color on dark backgrounds
Critical battery color on light backgrounds
Set the fill inside the battery ring separately for dark and light status-bar backgrounds. Default opacity is 75%.
Set the color used when the status bar sits on a dark or a light background.
Restore the low, charging, critical and power-saving fill colors to their defaults.
The low, charging, critical and power-saving fill colors will return to their defaults; custom colors will be overwritten.
Current %1$d: stroke width of the battery ring.
Current %1$d: thickness of the battery bar along the bottom.
Current %1$d: stroke width of the Wi-Fi arcs.
Current %1$d: Wi-Fi arc stroke width and vertical position inside the top slot.

Current %1$d sp: font size of the battery percentage. While centred, the percentage grows by at most 1.4×; values of 38 sp and above do not grow further, and the number in the notch still follows this setting.
Current weight %1$d: stroke weight of the battery number, 100 lightest to 900 heaviest.
Current %1$d: font size of the 3G/4G/5G label in the ring centre.

Current %1$d dp: font size of the 3G/4G/5G label shown outside the ring in the status bar. The default is 14 dp and the range is 8–26 dp. This label is drawn by the status bar itself, so the preview cell in Settings is its only live size reference.

Current %1$d%%: when the network type ends in A (such as 5GA), this is the trailing A size relative to the main label, aligned to its baseline. The default is 65%%; the range is 50–100%%, and 100%% means no shrink. Applies both inside the ring and outside it.

Current %1$d dp: gap between the out-of-ring network-type label and its outer side, facing away from the battery. The default is 2 dp and the range is 0–16 dp. The row mirrors in RTL layouts, moving this margin to the opposite side.

Current %1$d dp: gap between the out-of-ring network-type label and its inner side, facing the battery and out-of-ring reading. The default is 2 dp and the range is 0–16 dp. It mirrors in RTL layouts too.
Current weight %1$d: stroke weight of the network type, 100 lightest to 900 heaviest.

Current %1$d dp: overall height of the out-of-ring reading, in dp so it converts to pixels on any screen density. 15 dp matches the height of the status bar\'s own signal icon and is the default; the range is 6–20 dp. The same row is drawn at the same size whether or not a dot row follows it, so the two shapes never come out different sizes, and pulling down Quick Settings does not change it.

Current %1$d dp: controls only the gap between the self-drawn out-of-ring signal bars and the battery ring. It does not move the out-of-ring network-type label or change the overall left margin of the composite icon. Available only when Signal position is Outside the ring and Stacked signal is enabled.
Current %1$d%%: opacity of the unlit parts of the glyph.
Current %1$d%%: scale of the charging bolt; requires both the battery number and charging bolt to be enabled.
Current %1$d dp: horizontal position of the charging bolt; positive values move right.
Current %1$d dp: vertical position of the charging bolt; positive values move down.
Current %1$d dp: horizontal position of the entire composite icon; positive values move right.
Current %1$d dp: vertical position of the entire composite icon; positive values move down.
Current %1$d dp: extra spacing on the left of the composite icon, in addition to the native status-bar icons’ own padding.
Current %1$d dp: reserve spacing on the right of the composite icon.
Current %1$d%%: scale of the ring-style signal dots.
Current %1$d dp: centre-to-centre spacing of horizontal ring signal dots at 100%% overall size.
Current %1$d dp: shift ring signal dots horizontally; positive values move right.
Current %1$d dp: shift ring signal dots vertically; positive values move down.
